answer: One defence is Tax filing hash from a revenue authority: a filing receipt only the taxpayer holds, and the ledge of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a filing receipt only the taxpayer holds a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the terrace of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the forge of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
